title: Recommendations with Costly Verification
abstract: arXiv:2611.01195v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A recommender faces consumers who can verify recommendations, but differ in their attention costs or in the salience of their choice of adoption. We characterize the conditions under which a technology that increases transparency by lowering the cost of verifying a product's quality will increase or decrease false recommendations. Without commitment, reducing verification costs never increases false recommendations, but when the recommender can commit to a policy, transparency can worsen both the quality of recommendations and consumer welfare. The necessary and sufficient condition is that the log-elasticity of the distribution of consumer cost types is decreasing. It can hold when the distribution is sufficiently fat-tailed, or when it mixes sophisticated and naive consumers. Our results can be applied to platform-recommended listings, security ratings, and audits.

translated_abstract: 一个推荐者面对的消费者能够验证推荐内容，但他们在注意力成本或采纳选择显著性上存在差异。我们刻画了在何种条件下，通过降低验证产品质量成本来提升透明度的技术会增加或减少虚假推荐。在推荐者无法承诺的情况下，降低验证成本绝不会增加虚假推荐；但当推荐者能够承诺某项政策时，透明度反而可能同时恶化推荐质量和消费者福利。其充要条件是消费者成本类型分布的对数弹性递减。当分布足够厚尾，或当其混合了老练与天真的消费者时，该条件即可成立。我们的结果可应用于平台推荐商品、安全评级以及审计等场景。
tldr: 本文刻画了提升透明度（降低验证成本）何时会增加虚假推荐：在推荐者无承诺时透明度总有利的，但当推荐者可承诺政策时，若消费者成本类型分布的对数弹性递减（如分布足够厚尾或混合老练与天真消费者），透明度反而会同时恶化推荐质量和消费者福利。
en_tdlr: Lowering verification costs never increases false recommendations when the recommender lacks commitment, but when it can commit to a policy, transparency can worsen both recommendation quality and consumer welfare if the log-elasticity of the consumer cost-type distribution is decreasing.
